title: KL to Genting Highlands: Bus, Car Charter, Cable Car
metaDescription: KL to Genting Highlands by express bus from KL Sentral, TBS or Gombak, the direct bus from KLIA2, a car with driver, and the cable car to the top.

contentBlocks.content: To get from KL to Genting Highlands, take an express bus from KL Sentral, TBS, Pudu Sentral, Pekeliling or Terminal Bersepadu Gombak. The bus stops at the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Terminal at Sky Sentral, halfway up the mountain. From there the Awana SkyWay cable car takes you to the top in about 10 minutes. Landing at KLIA2? A direct bus runs from the airport, so you do not need to go into KL first. With a group or heavy bags, book a car with driver instead.
Key Takeaways
Where do buses from KL leave? KL Sentral (Lower Ground floor), TBS, Pudu Sentral, Pekeliling and Terminal Bersepadu Gombak.
Does the bus go to the top? No. It stops at Sky Sentral, mid-hill. You ride the Awana SkyWay cable car up to SkyAvenue.
How much is the bus from KL Sentral? RM10 for an adult on the Resorts World Genting bus, or RM20 with the cable car included, checked on 5 November 2026.
Can I go straight from KLIA2? Yes. A direct bus leaves the KLIA2 Transportation Hub for Genting. Book it on ttklia.com before you fly.
When does the cable car run? The Awana SkyWay runs from 7AM to 11PM.
KL to Genting by express bus

Resorts World Genting runs its own express bus from KL Sentral and from Terminal Bersepadu Gombak (TBG) to the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Terminal. Other operators run from TBS, Pudu Sentral and Pekeliling. This is the departure list Resorts World Genting publishes (Resorts World Genting, Express Bus), checked on 5 November 2026:

At KL Sentral, the bus terminal is on the Lower Ground floor. A Resorts World Genting bus ticket costs RM10 for an adult and RM7 for a child, senior or guest with disabilities. From TBG it is RM12 and RM9. The bus and cable car combo from KL Sentral costs RM20 for an adult (Resorts World Genting). The Gombak ticket counter moved from Gombak LRT Station to TBG on 1 July 2025, so go to TBG (Resorts World Genting, Getting Here).

The resort's page links to redBus for online tickets. You can also buy bus and cable car tickets together at the express bus counter at KL Sentral (Resorts World Genting, Sky Sentral). Times change without notice, so check the timetable on the morning you travel, then pick a bus that leaves you daylight at the top.
Landing at KLIA2? Take the direct bus to Genting

You do not need to ride into KL first. ttklia.com sells a direct bus from KLIA2 to Awana Genting Highland, the bus terminal at Sky Sentral. The operators are AeroBus and Resorts World Tour. The bus leaves from the KLIA2 Transportation Hub on Level 1, one floor below the arrival hall (ttklia.com). Resorts World Genting lists AeroBus departures from KLIA2 at 2PM and 6PM (Resorts World Genting), but check the departures on the booking page for your date.

The fare is shown on the booking page and includes the terminal fee. Book before you fly so you know your departure time while you are still on the plane. If you have not walked through KLIA2 before, read our KLIA2 bus station guide first. It takes you from arrivals to the bus counter step by step.

content.heading: Book the KLIA2 bus to Genting Highlands
content.subheading: Direct from the KLIA2 Transportation Hub, Level 1. Pick a departure and keep the e-ticket on your phone.

contentBlocks.content: Up the mountain: Awana SkyWay or Genting SkyWay

The Awana SkyWay starts at Sky Sentral, where your bus stops. Go up to Level 4 to board. The gondola stops at Chin Swee Station, where you can get off for Chin Swee Caves Temple at no extra cost, then carries on to Genting Highlands Station on Level 4 of SkyAvenue. The ride is 2.8 km and takes about 10 minutes. It runs from 7AM to 11PM (Resorts World Genting, Awana SkyWay).

A standard gondola costs RM11 one way or RM19 return. Children under 90 cm ride free. Tickets bought ahead are valid for 30 days. Each passenger can take one cabin size bag; an oversized bag costs RM22 one way. Bigger bags can stay at the baggage counter on Level 2 of Sky Sentral, open 24 hours, from RM22.

The resort has a second cable car. The Genting SkyWay runs 3.4 km from Gohtong Sentral Station to Resorts World Station at the peak, in about 15 minutes, and lists its hours as 9AM to 7PM (Resorts World Genting, Genting SkyWay). When the Awana SkyWay closes for maintenance, the standard Awana fares apply on the Genting SkyWay. Check which line is running on the day before you set off.

Do not want the cable car? Resorts World Genting says you can reach the hilltop by car or taxi instead (Resorts World Genting, Sky Sentral). Buy your cable car ticket online or at Sky Sentral, and keep it on your phone if you plan to stop at Chin Swee.
By car with driver, Grab or your own car

A car with driver takes you from your door to Genting on your schedule. ttklia.com sells car charters of 8 or 10 hours, and the charter covers Genting Highlands. The cars listed run from a 4 seat car up to the 10 seat Mercedes Sprinter (ttklia.com). Listed prices exclude 6% SST. For a full day plan with the temple and the outlets, read our Genting Highlands day trip by private driver.

Grab works from KL hotels and from the airport. Resorts World Genting lists an e-hailing partner with special rates from KLIA and the Klang Valley on its getting here page (Resorts World Genting). Driving yourself? Park at the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets car park, which adjoins Sky Sentral, and take the cable car up (Resorts World Genting). Decide how you are travelling, then read things to do in Genting to plan your time at the top.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I get from KL to Genting by bus?

Take an express bus from KL Sentral, TBS, Pudu Sentral, Pekeliling or Terminal Bersepadu Gombak to the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Terminal at Sky Sentral. Then ride the Awana SkyWay cable car to the top.
How much is the bus from KL Sentral to Genting Highlands?
The Resorts World Genting bus from KL Sentral costs RM10 for an adult, or RM20 with the cable car included, according to Resorts World Genting on 5 November 2026. Other operators set their own fares.
Is there a bus from KLIA to Genting Highlands?
Yes, there is a direct bus from KLIA2 to Genting Highlands. It leaves the KLIA2 Transportation Hub on Level 1 and stops at Sky Sentral. Book it on ttklia.com, where the fare and departures are shown.
Does the bus from KL go to the top of Genting Highlands?
No, the express bus stops at Sky Sentral, mid-hill. Take the Awana SkyWay from Level 4 of Sky Sentral to Genting Highlands Station at SkyAvenue, about 10 minutes.
What time is the last bus from Genting to KL Sentral?
The last Resorts World Genting bus from the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Terminal to KL Sentral leaves at 10.30PM, on the timetable checked on 5 November 2026. Times change, so check on the day.
Conclusion

From KL to Genting Highlands, take the express bus to Sky Sentral and ride the Awana SkyWay up. From the airport, skip KL and book the direct KLIA2 bus to Genting on ttklia.com. With a group, book an 8 or 10 hour car charter and ask what is included when you book.
